拥有[狂热]时，提升{3}攻击力与{4}移动速度加成。[狂热]层数大于6时，额外提升{5}攻击力与{6}移动速度加成，对瘫痪目标造成伤害提升{7}。

skill.descEnRank5:
Summon a Mimic Chest that constantly spits out gold coins. When picked up, the coin restores 8.00% HP and 40 Stamina for the Resonator, and applies Fervor to all nearby Resonators in the team for 20s.
Obtaining Fervor increases ATK by 40.00% and Movement Speed by 25.00%. Having more than 6 stacks of Fervor additionally increases ATK by 40.00%, Movement Speed by 25.00%, and DMG dealt to Immobilized targets by 100.00%.
CD: 35s
